title: 第一卷 第6109章 绝世高手到来第一卷 第6108章 吞天王座
content_zh:
猛！
这一道波动，实在是太猛了。
在繁衍出来的刹那，叶寒完全封锁不住，就已经冲出了这座上古魔墓。
大势冲霄，在这颗星辰的上方形成了弥天彻地的异象。
整颗星辰，乃至下一刻，直接传递到星河之上。
那是一团巨大无比的气芒，在其中无数道光痕扭曲、变幻着，扰乱了星河的运转。
那气芒，蔓延出无比神秘特殊的波动。
似神非神，似魔非魔，神魔一体，亦正亦邪。
站在远处的赵怡等三人，心灵再一次狠狠颤抖起来。
他们，知晓这位叶公子的强大与不凡。
知晓这是一尊未来经历过“神变”之后，只会更加恐怖无双的存在。
只是怎么也都没想到，那几尊序列之王，都未曾打开过的上古魔墓，居然这么快就被这位自称叶无忌的生灵所开启了。
“不好！”
“快，先藏起来。”
突然，赵怡大惊失色。
几乎在她开口的同时，金鼎和金元二人的脸色也瞬息骤变。
三道身影，在第一时间退避开来，隐匿在了更远处。
几乎在他们离开的刹那。
轰隆！
一道通天的大手，从星河之巅降临下来。

这大手，只是一出现，就已然有一种将天地万物都笼罩在其中，一念之间直接碾碎一切的迹象。
这一幕，实在是太过可怖。
恐怖！
恐怖至极！
这大手的主人，俨然终焉之主的领域，都已经走了很长的一段路。
此时这一出手，哪怕站在遥远星河之外的诸多试炼者，都感应到了，只感受到一股浓浓的窒息感。
“裂空少主！”
“那是裂空少主，没想到他居然进入了葬神之地，之前没有任何的踪迹。”
不少试炼者大惊失色。
裂空少主，那是一尊极度恐怖的存在。
在第八层诸天之中，可以说赫赫有名，身负可怕的传承不谈，其自身的天赋与境界、战力，也是强横无边。
这种生灵，就算是不前来参加禁忌试炼，他想要加入天禁神殿那种势力，成为其中的序列之子，都不过是一句话的事情而已，没有丝毫难度。
但是谁都没有想到，裂空少主居然出现在了葬神之地，一直以来都无声无息，不显山露水。
直到今日此刻，突然出手了？
这种可怕的气势……
已然是无限接近那三位序列之王了。
或者说，这裂空少主，伴随着此次参加禁忌试炼，回去之后很可能得到天禁神殿的认可，同样晋升为序列之王？
content_en:
fierce!
This fluctuation is really too violent.
The moment it multiplied, Ye Han couldn't block it at all and had already rushed out of the ancient demon tomb.
The general trend soared into the sky, forming a heaven-shattering vision above the star.
The entire star, and even the next moment, is directly transmitted to the galaxy.
It was a huge mass of light, in which countless traces of light twisted and changed, disrupting the movement of the galaxy.
That aura spread out extremely mysterious and special fluctuations.
Like gods but not gods, like demons but not demons, gods and demons are one, both good and evil.
Zhao Yi and the other three people standing in the distance felt their hearts tremble again.
They knew how powerful and extraordinary this Young Master Ye was.
Knowing that this is a being that will only become more terrifying and unparalleled after experiencing a "divine transformation" in the future.
But I never expected that the ancient demon tomb that none of the sequence kings had opened would be opened so quickly by this creature who called himself Ye Wuji.
"Not good!"
"Quick, hide first."
Suddenly, Zhao Yi was shocked.
Almost at the same time she spoke, the expressions of Jin Ding and Jin Yuan also changed suddenly.
The three figures immediately retreated and hid further away.
Almost as soon as they left.
Boom!
A huge hand reaching the sky descended from the top of the galaxy.
As soon as this big hand appeared, it already seemed to envelop everything in the world and crush everything in a single thought.
This scene is really too terrifying.
fear!
Extremely scary!
The master of this big hand, the realm of the master of the end, has come a long way.
At this time, even many trialists standing far away from the galaxy felt this move, and they only felt a strong sense of suffocation.
"Young Master Split Kong!"
"That's Young Master Split Kong. I didn't expect that he actually entered the God Burial Ground. There was no trace of him before."
Many trialists were shocked.
Young Master Split Kong is an extremely terrifying existence.
In the eighth level of the heavens, it can be said that he is famous. Not to mention the terrifying inheritance, his own talent, realm, and combat power are also boundless.
For this kind of creature, even if he does not come to participate in the forbidden trial, if he wants to join a force like the Heavenly Forbidden Temple and become a son of the sequence, it is just a matter of words, without any difficulty.
But no one expected that Young Master Likong would actually appear in the God Burial Ground. He had been silent and invisible all this time.
Until today, he suddenly took action?
This terrifying momentum...
It is already infinitely close to the three sequence kings.
In other words, after participating in the forbidden trial this time, Young Master Splitting the Sky is likely to be recognized by the Heavenly Forbidden Temple and promoted to the King of Sequence after returning?
